description: Change a webhook's url, its event subscriptions, or enable/disable it. A true patch — omitted arguments are left alone. enabled:false is the safe way to stop deliveries: it keeps the subscription and its signing secret, so it can be turned back on. delete_webhook cannot be undone. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES update_webhook"]

enabled.description: false pauses deliveries without discarding the subscription.

events.description: REPLACES the whole subscription list (1–20 events), it does not add to it.

take_ownership.description: true makes YOU the webhook's owner. A webhook acts with its owner's access, so when the owner is demoted, removed or was never recorded, deliveries pause (list_webhooks shows paused_reason) until an admin does this.

url.description: New https endpoint on a public host.

webhook.description: Webhook id, or its exact url (from list_webhooks).

name: update_webhook
title: Update webhook
